content.text: Sixteen white round columns, five bricks tall.
Cella: inner shell, five courses, doorway on the east end.
Entablature beam ring on the column tops.
Low-pitch stepped gable roof with white tympanum infill.
Tympanum plates stacked on top of the roof instead of filling the gable — removing and re-seating them.
Verdict SOUND. Tying the loose base-edge bricks into one structure.
Two join-ties landed outside the footprint — removing them; the nosing ring already bonds the edge.
Removing the ties that landed outside the footprint.
The join-ties shifted six nosing plates into mid-air; removing and re-laying them properly.
